## Dashboard Rules

- Keep project-level condition, trend, confidence, preferences, and next-action fields here.
- Keep item-level state, owners, dates, evidence, and relationships in the registers.
- Keep process applicability, state, triggers, and process-run links in `process-register.md`.
- Keep artifact ownership and canonical locations in `artifact-index.md`.
- Treat any dashboard value derived from a register as a view, not a second record.
- Reconcile canonical artifacts and register changes only after the process review gate.
- Do not mark a register item closed, approved, assigned, scoped, or escalated without PM direction.
- Keep the control-root path and project identity stable so the agent does not mix projects.

## Latest Approved Feature Increment

CHG-46 (Separate users by account state) and CHG-47 (Add a support contact to the registration pending page) were approved on 2026-09-10. The administrator Members page now uses exclusive server-backed account-state tabs with live pending counts, and the registration pending page now provides a secondary clickable `mailto:leadhub@ssd.org` support contact. Local implementation and automated verification are complete; ACT-66 (Implement and verify administrator account-state tabs and pending counts) and ACT-67 (Implement and verify the registration-pending support contact) remain In Progress pending authenticated browser, responsive, staging, and launch acceptance. No additional maintained artifact is currently needed, and no schedule baseline changed.

CHG-36 (Rename the session Category field to Season end to end) and CHG-37 (Add server-side member search by name or email to the administrator Members page) were approved on 2026-09-02. Season remains a free-text field with existing values preserved. Member search remains server-side and combines with status filtering and fixed pagination. Local implementation and automated verification are complete in commit `5725fe1c` (`feat: rename session categories and search members`) on published branch `feature/season-member-search`; PR #11 (feat: rename session categories and search members) was merged into `main`. Authenticated browser, responsive, and staging acceptance were confirmed complete by the PM on 2026-09-07; launch acceptance remains open. ACT-54 (Implement and verify the end-to-end Season rename) and ACT-55 (Implement and verify administrator member search by name or email) are Resolved. No additional maintained artifact is currently needed.

CHG-38 (Expand protected supporting-material uploads to common document, presentation, text, and image formats) was approved on 2026-09-02. Lead Lab now accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, PPT, PPTX, JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP files up to 25 MB per file while retaining private authenticated downloads and one-material replacement. Local implementation and automated verification are complete in commit `8404a6f6` (`feat: expand supporting material uploads`) on published branch `feature/supporting-material-file-types`; PR #17 (`feat: expand supporting material uploads`) is open against `staging` with review requested from Dennis (`dennisatssd`). ACT-58 (Implement and verify supporting-material file type expansion and the 25 MB limit) remains In Progress pending authenticated browser, responsive, staging request-limit, storage and backup, and launch acceptance. PHPStan still reports one pre-existing `bootstrap/app.php` `env()` warning; no additional maintained artifact is currently needed.
